title: Findings Resulting in Directive for Social Media Platforms to Block of 95 Accounts for Posts on Singapore's Leadership Transition
what_it_is: Findings Resulting in Directive for Social Media Platforms to Block of 95 Accounts for Posts on Singapore's Leadership Transition

sections.label: Foreign interference and FICA directions
sections.summary: No further posts came from the 95 accounts after 10 May 2024, no Singapore-based responsibility was found, and FICA directions may be used against hostile interference.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: After 10 May 2024, we did not detect any further posts from the network of 95 accounts carrying malicious narratives on Singapore's leadership transition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Our investigations have not found any evidence that Singaporeans or persons based in Singapore are responsible for the 95 accounts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Thirdly, are there other hostile interferences, maybe not as large scale as the one that was just mentioned, but especially of those sponsored by the state?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We monitor the online space and we will not hesitate to use appropriate levers, including the use of our FICA directions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For national security reasons, we are not able to disclose details of operations against foreign interference in Singapore.
